'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Ross Littauer LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ross Littauer]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
